description: Cache hit accounting: needs an endpoint that actually returns cache traffic; the prior endpoint returned cacheReadTokens: 0

decisiveEvidence.reproducibility: Confirmed non-zero and stable across 3 independent process runs (9 total calls), each showing cache_read_input_tokens: 2304 once the ephemeral cache_control prefix was warm.
runArtifacts: evidence/phase-7/obs-gates/p357-run1-run2-driver.mjs (the driver script used for all 3 runs)

otherRoutesTriedAndTheirStatus.note: OAuth access token has been revoked -- real Anthropic route, currently broken auth on this router instance

pipelineVerification.claim: Non-zero cache_read_input_tokens from the raw Anthropic-format router response is correctly plumbed all the way to the TUI's cache-hit UI field, end to end, at the source level

chain.step: Router raw response (Anthropic Messages API shape)
@ai-sdk/anthropic provider internals map raw field to LanguageModelV2Usage
ai package's asLanguageModelUsage() normalizes provider usage to the public LanguageModelUsage shape
stream-handler.ts reads this exact field on step-finish and forwards it as a stream-event
observability.ts applyUsage() accumulates this field per-agent on every step-finish/usage-update event
AgentsView.tsx TokensView and InspectView compute the visible cache-hit percentage from this exact field

pipelineVerification.verifiedByLiveDrive: During the P3.5.5 investigation, a real driven session against model glm/glm-4.7 (task 001-ctx-test) showed the TOKENS sub-view rendering 'CACHE HIT ████████ 100%' with real climbing prompt-token totals -- confirming the UI field is not merely wired in source but actually renders non-zero/populated values from a real running session using the same route proven to emit cache_read_input_tokens.

conclusion: PASS. glm/glm-4.7 through the local router is a real, currently-live endpoint that returns non-zero cache_read_input_tokens (2304, reproduced 3x across independent process runs). The field-mapping chain from raw provider response through @ai-sdk/anthropic, the ai package's usage normalization, stream-handler.ts, observability.ts, and finally AgentsView.tsx's cache-hit percentage calculation is confirmed correct at every hop by source inspection, and a live driven TUI session against this exact model rendered a populated (100%) cache-hit figure in the TOKENS sub-view. This closes the P3.5.7 gap: an endpoint that actually returns cache traffic exists (glm/glm-4.7), and the UI's cache accounting correctly derives from it.
